legacy_root.title: License and credit propagation lattice through fusion
legacy_root.question: Implement most-restrictive-wins license propagation and credit carry-through for fusion, seeded by the 7 license_classification_rules and the 45-row license_risk_register in the provenance graph. Question: for every fusion whose sources span more than one license class, what is the resulting license, which combinations are prohibited outright, and does any fusion currently lose an attribution required by a source?
legacy_root.answer: On the catalog-reconstructed-fixture corpus, 22 of 30 fusions span more than one effective license class: 16 ALLOWED (most-restrictive-wins), 4 PROHIBITED (copyleft+proprietary or any rider fusion; alternative CLEAN-ROOM-REIMPLEMENT), 2 BLOCKED (unresolved or UNKNOWN, never permissive). Credit loss on 2 fusion(s): ['MU-22', 'MU-29']. Copyleft+permissive control yields STRONG_COPYLEFT; unknown control is BLOCKED. Live 08-WORKFLOW-PROVENANCE-AND-LICENSE-GRAPH.json and 10-WORKFLOW-MERGE-AND-COMPOSITION-MAPS.json are absent on this worktree; the 7 rules and 45-row register are reconstructed from the WFA-0033 catalog histogram (26/11/2/1/1) plus four seed-extension rows, and the 30 merge_units are fixtures with the documented field names. Results are computed by lattice.fuse, not asserted. Not legal advice; catalog owner_approval_required remains open for any redistribution decision. UNKNOWN never defaults to PERMISSIVE. SUCCESS:WFA-0139
legacy_root.mechanism: most-restrictive-wins license lattice with fail-closed unknown handling

classification_rules.title: Map a known SPDX token onto a lattice class
Missing, UNKNOWN, or UNCLASSIFIED license never defaults to permissive
A vendor rider or field-of-use restriction is RIDER-RESTRICTED regardless of SPDX
Attribution, NOTICE, and CC-BY credits must carry through fusion
OWNER-AUTHORED-WITH-EXTERNAL-DEPENDENCY inherits the most-restrictive dependency class
Join is max(rank); a copyleft+permissive pair yields copyleft
Copyleft+proprietary and any rider fusion are PROHIBITED; unresolved source license BLOCKS
